changes: Audio tracks: pitch bend moves the track's pitch by up to PB RANGE semitones (default 2).
MW DEST and AT DEST send the mod wheel and aftertouch to a parameter of the track's sound, by MW AMT and AT AMT.
Everything adds to the track's own value and LFOs, within the parameter's range; changing track stops it.
Known issue: not yet tested on a unit.
Pitch bend, aftertouch and the mod wheel now add to the MIDI track's own value (its knob, parameter locks and LFO), capped to the MIDI limits.
A held bend no longer jumps back when the track sends its own value.
Selecting another track gives the previous synth back the track's own values; the new track follows only when you next move a control.
Unticking a row gives the track its own value back.
Known issue: not yet tested on a unit.
First release for Digitakt I OS 1.54, on Core 2.1. SETTINGS > PB THRU, AT THRU and MW THRU pass pitch bend, aftertouch and the mod wheel from MIDI IN to the synth a MIDI track plays.
They follow the notes: the AUTO CHANNEL to the active MIDI track, a TRACK CHANNEL to that track, sent on the track's CHAN.
Sequencer notes and controls go out first. DIN MIDI OUT only. Unticked, MIDI is stock.
The settings are not saved and start unticked at every power-on.
Known issue: not yet tested on a unit.
